literal_meaning: চোখে আটকে যাওয়া বা চোখে পড়া
figurative_meaning_en: To appear clearly or noticeably; to seem out of place or inappropriate
similar_in_english: Stick out like a sore thumb
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই নতুন সাজসজ্জা চোখে লাগছে, খুব সুন্দর।
example_sentences_in_english: Your rude behavior is sticking out to me.
This new decoration catches the eye; it's very beautiful.
note: The idiom can convey both positive noticeability and negative incongruity depending on context.
